fusions.name: From Dead Stillness
fusions.desc: A sudden full-length thrust of the staff at an enemy up to 4 tiles away that deals 14 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Length
fusions.desc: Spends 4% of your maximum health to strike with the staff, dealing 8 damage and chilling the target for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunning on the Post
fusions.desc: You lean motionless on the staff and restore 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail Regrows
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you brace on the staff and regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
